reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur) / SUM(net_revenue_eur), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL
  AND units IS NOT NULL
  AND unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY parent_category
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur) / SUM(net_revenue_eur) >= 20
